description:
Priority: P1 (docs/agents). File: CLAUDE.md. Reference: hare (gold standard meta-structure).

Problem: ~356 lines of hexagonal theory + Salvo/SeaORM cheatsheet with ZERO workflow content. Also contains an inaccurate project-structure tree (claims src/db/ and a src/utils.rs file; reality is src/utils/ with utils/db.rs, and there is no src/db/).

Change: Restructure to hare's shape: service-purpose intro -> Build Commands (cargo make / bacon / nextest) -> Story / Session Tracking (lift hare's, generic) -> architecture -> "Adding a New Entity" runbook (promote from TEMPLATE.md, which is deleted on init) -> Telemetry (link OPENTELEMETRY.md, inline middleware order) -> CI / Infrastructure -> Agent guardrails (e.g. the clippy ratchet rule). Fix the structure tree to match reality. Drop the copy-pasted Tailwind/Alpine and SQLx blocks the siblings carry (do not introduce them here).

Acceptance: CLAUDE.md documents how to build, test, monitor, and add a feature; structure tree matches the actual src/ layout; Telemetry section links OPENTELEMETRY.md.
Depends on: TPL-006 (so documented cargo make monitor/coverage exist), TPL-013 (so the Story section references a real .story/).
title: [TPL-010] Rewrite CLAUDE.md as a runbook
